project.title: Metagenomic Profiling of Microbial Ecology in Sugar Industry Wastewater
project.description: This study explores the hidden microbial world in sugar industry wastewater through metagenomic sequencing. By capturing and analyzing the complete DNA of microbial communities, it reveals the diversity, ecological interactions, and functional potential of bacteria, archaea, and fungi in this industrial wastewater environment, offering insights for sustainable waste management and biotechnological applications.
